note: Every source is identified by exact commit SHA and its HEAD is verified (no branch, tag or default-branch substitution). The Control Plane checkout MUST have full history in the hosted run (the tripwire diffs the G2 head against merged G1 main). Layout: <CAP_SRC_DIR>/<dir>. The Control Plane pin is re-pinnable: set CAP_CP_SHA (and CAP_CP_BASE_SHA) in the environment to qualify a later head; the default is the value below.

control_plane.role: unit under test: G2 head (modules registry_authority_state and registry_authority_profile) on top of merged G1 main

control_plane_base.role: G2 base: merged G1 main (an ancestor of the G2 head inside the full-history control_plane checkout; not a separate directory)

registry.role: real verifier core v2_verified_selection (verify_f4_selection_v2), real Ed25519Verifier, conformance kit registry_conformance.highwater, test builders r08_support/s01_support

replay.role: pinned for parity with G1 (the G1 regression imports it); G2 tests do not use Replay directly
